claim_scope: Same-study, donor-disjoint and physical-pool-disjoint transfer of composition-inclusive RNA-surface-protein dependence among unstimulated PBMC aliquots. This is not whole-file holdout because all conditions share one H5AD and each donor's sealed non-control aliquots occur in other pools; those non-control rows are never analyzed.

candidate_binding.verification: Before axis preflight, require an annotated public tag whose local and remote tag objects and peeled commits agree, whose candidate path is byte-identical to the tagged path, and whose peeled commit is an ancestor of every later campaign tag.

input_binding.numeric_matrix_schema: AnnData X CSR encoding-version 0.1.0 with shape 136142 by 20399; exact HDF5 dataset paths, axis hashes, and input digests remain PENDING_AXIS_PREFLIGHT
input_binding.binding_rule: The opaque compressed file, decompressed H5AD, exact HDF5 paths and storage encodings, complete obs and var axes, modality labels, shapes, and hashes must be published under an annotated axis-preflight tag before any numeric matrix dataset is dereferenced. A PENDING value is a closed gate.

permitted: opaque download and byte hashing of the compressed file
opaque decompression and byte hashing of the H5AD
HDF5 group names, dataset names, shapes, dtypes, encodings, and attributes
the H5AD obs index and exact obs columns cond, exp_id, free_id, and batch
the complete var identifier and modality axes needed to bind the 17 frozen cognates
forbidden: dereferencing any AnnData X numeric matrix value array
dereferencing any raw/X or layers numeric value array
decoding a sparse matrix data, indices, or indptr dataset
computing RNA or protein values, states, margins, joint tables, graph profiles, model fits, or losses
required_checks: the obs and var indices contain exactly 136142 and 20399 unique values, respectively
cond == C contains exactly 22732 cells and 64 exp_id donors, and cond == 0 contains exactly 455 excluded anomaly rows
the feature axis contains exactly 20303 GRCh38 genes and 96 BD99AbSeq proteins, converting this expected metadata claim into a committed axis certificate
obs contains exact columns cond, exp_id, free_id, and batch
all retained rows satisfy cond == C and no retained row satisfies cond == 0
exp_id and free_id are one-to-one across retained control donors
the batch axis is exactly the integers zero through eleven
every frozen RNA and protein label resolves by exact equality exactly once
the frozen role and donor allocation is reproduced exactly
the excluded control-cell counts are exp_id 23: 2, 62: 64, 51: 70, and 52: 91, and every designated donor has at least 128 control-cell identifiers before any assay value is read
axis_only_preflight.failure_policy: Any mismatch is a terminal metadata/schema refusal. Do not inspect numeric X, repair labels, replace a donor, change a role, or amend the panel after a mismatch.

source_development.cross_validation: Nested leave-one-physical-pool-out validation. Each of eight outer folds seals one complete source pool. Hyperparameters are selected by inner leave-one-pool-out validation over the seven outer-training pools, then the selected model is refit on those seven pools and scored once on the outer pool. Rebuild the comparison mask, normalization, hypergraphs, estimators, and predictions inside every inner and outer training set. Aggregate outer loss as the equal mean of the eight outer-pool means; donors are equal within pool.

internal_validation.role: sealed internal validation of the source-selected candidate and complete decision contract

primary_confirmation.role: primary held-pool confirmation; accessible only after the internal stage passes every frozen gate

allocation.order: batch ascending, then integer exp_id ascending
allocation.pseudoreplication_rule: Cells and the 289 RNA-by-protein tables are repeated measurements within donor and are never treated as inferential replicates.
allocation.whole_file_boundary: Roles are disjoint only for cond == C aliquots at the donor and physical-pool levels. Non-control aliquots from sealed donors can occupy other pools in the same H5AD and are excluded from every analysis stage.

panel.modality_rule: Resolve RNA features on var/genome == GRCh38 and protein features on var/genome == BD99AbSeq. Do not use var/feature_types, which labels both modalities as Gene Expression in this H5AD.
panel.feature_resolution: Resolve each RNA symbol by exact equality exactly once among GRCh38 features and each protein_exact_feature by exact equality exactly once among BD99AbSeq features. protein_target is display metadata only. No aliases, case folding, fuzzy matching, aggregation, substitution, marker removal, or reordering.

cell_and_state_construction.cell_selection: Within exact cond == C, exp_id, and batch, require unique obs identifiers, order cells by SHA256('GSE181897-CONTROL-CELL-BUDGET-v1|' + str(batch) + '|' + str(exp_id) + '|' + obs_index) and then obs_index, select the first 128, and restore their deposited obs order before matrix reduction.
cell_and_state_construction.rna_state: Raw RNA count greater than zero is state 1; zero is state 0.
cell_and_state_construction.protein_state: Raw protein count greater than zero is state 1; zero is state 0.
cell_and_state_construction.marker_validity: An RNA or protein marker is valid for a donor when 4 through 124 of the 128 cells are in state 1.
cell_and_state_construction.coordinate_validity: A donor coordinate is scored only when both its RNA and protein markers are valid and its fixed margins admit more than one 2-by-2 table.
cell_and_state_construction.destroyed_link: Within each donor, order the selected obs identifiers by the destroyed-link salt and cyclically shift the complete 17-marker binary protein-state row by one position. This preserves every protein margin and the multivariate protein-state rows while destroying same-cell RNA-protein pairing.

profile_construction.rna: For each donor and RNA marker, use the Jeffreys-smoothed logit log((positive+0.5)/(128-positive+0.5)).
profile_construction.protein: For each selected cell, compute log1p raw protein count minus the mean log1p count across the complete 96-protein axis; average this cellwise CLR over the donor for each frozen protein marker.
profile_construction.normalization: Within each training set, subtract each physical pool's donor mean separately for every marker and divide by that marker's pooled within-pool standard deviation. A zero or nonfinite pooled standard deviation is a model refusal; it is never replaced. Validation and held profiles never enter normalization or graph construction.

source_only_comparison_mask.universe: All 289 ordered RNA-by-protein coordinates in frozen panel order.
source_only_comparison_mask.construction: Construct a mask independently inside every inner or outer source training problem and once from all 39 source donors. For D training donors, retain a coordinate only if at least ceil(D/2) donors have valid informative tables, the pooled observed n11 is strictly between the summed fixed-margin lower and upper bounds, and all four cells of the unstratified donor-pooled 2-by-2 table are positive. Never intersect masks across folds and never use a validation pool to determine its training mask. Only the all-39-source mask is frozen for internal and confirmation stages; held data cannot add, remove, or reorder a coordinate.
source_only_comparison_mask.same_mask_rule: Every method is evaluated on the identical source-only comparison mask intersected with that donor's frozen coordinate-validity mask. Method-specific success on otherwise excluded coordinates is descriptive and cannot enter a head-to-head gate.
source_only_comparison_mask.primary_full_field: The penalty-complete primary is also fitted on the complete 289-coordinate field with zero minimum informative-donor support, but confirmatory method comparisons use only the common mask.
source_only_comparison_mask.publication: The source artifact must publish every independently constructed inner/outer training mask, the all-39-source held mask, ordered coordinate labels, canonical array hashes, support certificates, and per-donor scored-coordinate counts before internal numeric access. Every training mask and the final held mask must retain at least 232 coordinates; each evaluated donor must have at least 232 supported coordinates on the applicable mask.

primary_estimator.parameter: One population full log-odds interaction for each ordered RNA-by-protein coordinate plus donor deviations penalized toward the population field.
primary_estimator.likelihood: Exact conditional likelihood of each donor 2-by-2 table given its observed row and column margins.
primary_estimator.zero_support_semantics: Positive heterogeneity and ridge penalties give a unique finite penalized fit even when a coordinate has no informative source table. Such a coordinate is labeled a penalty-propagated prediction, never a data-identified effect.
primary_estimator.hypergraph: Build separate marker-centered hypergraphs from training-only normalized RNA and protein profiles. Each marker defines one hyperedge containing itself and its k nearest markers, with duplicate membership removed. Use the Cartesian-product hypergraph Laplacian on the 17 by 17 population field.
primary_estimator.recipient_prediction: Transport the fitted population log odds by the frozen multiplier and combine it with recipient row and column margins through the exact noncentral-hypergeometric expectation.
primary_estimator.selection: In each inner training problem, Stage A selects heterogeneity penalty, ridge penalty, and transport multiplier using graph zero. Stage B fixes those values and selects k and positive graph penalty. A configuration is eligible only if it completes every inner held-pool fold. Minimize equal-pool mean donor loss and resolve exact ties lexicographically by the parameter order listed above. Apply the selected inner configuration once to its outer held pool. After the nested source gate, repeat the same inner leave-one-pool-out selection over all eight source pools and refit the final selected configuration once on all 39 source donors.
primary_estimator.matched_graph_zero: Use identity incidence matrices, graph penalty zero, and the primary-selected heterogeneity penalty, ridge penalty, and transport multiplier. Do not construct a profile graph.

common_effect_cmle.selection: For each source fold and the final source set, solve one exact conditional score equation per comparison coordinate and select the transport multiplier from the primary multiplier grid by source CV. No continuity correction or ridge is permitted.

unstratified_pooled_poisson.family: unstratified saturated 2-by-2 Poisson log-linear interaction after pooling source donors
unstratified_pooled_poisson.selection: Pool complete donor tables by coordinate without donor strata, require all four pooled cells positive, reconstruct the fitted pooled table to normalized absolute error at most 1e-8, and select the transport multiplier by source CV.

classical_residual_coordinate.definition: For each informative source donor and coordinate, compute the signed one-degree-of-freedom statistic against Poisson independence and divide by sqrt(128). Average across eligible source donors, apply a candidate transport multiplier, multiply by sqrt(128), and monotonically invert the statistic on the recipient fixed-margin support.
classical_residual_coordinate.selection: Select a multiplier separately for each family by source CV, then lock the lower-loss family as the single primary classical comparator. This is an interaction coordinate, not a cellwise residual vector.

comparators.independence: Use the row-plus-column Poisson independence table determined only by recipient margins.
comparators.destroyed_link: Fix every primary structural parameter except reselecting only the transport multiplier by source CV after the deterministic within-donor protein-row shift. Refit on all source donors. This is a pairing ablation, not a separately optimized estimator.

topology_nulls.construction: For each null, independently permute RNA and protein incidence-matrix rows with a deterministic nonidentity permutation. Preserve the corresponding unpermuted candidate spectrum and rerun the complete Stage-B k by graph-penalty source selection before final refit.
topology_nulls.empirical_p: (1 + number of null mean losses less than or equal to the primary mean loss) / 64

comparators.same_information_rule: All estimators use the same source donors, nested source folds, 128 selected cells, ordered panel, recipient margins, applicable comparison coordinates, and donor loss. No comparator may use internal or confirmation outcomes for selection.

loss.per_coordinate: For observed table T, margin-preserving prediction P, and N=128, use (2/N) times sum over four cells T_ij log(T_ij/P_ij), with a zero observed cell contributing zero.
loss.per_donor: Arithmetic mean of per-coordinate deviance over the common source-only mask intersected with the donor-valid coordinate mask.
loss.per_batch: Arithmetic mean of donor losses within the physical batch.
loss.source_selection: Arithmetic mean of the eight held-source-batch mean losses.
loss.held_summary: Arithmetic mean of the two physical-batch mean losses. This preserves equal pool weight; donor-equal results are reported as a sensitivity.

source_go_gate.bootstrap: Use 20000 paired bootstrap draws, resampling donors with replacement independently within each of the eight outer held pools and recomputing the equal-pool mean difference. Derive deterministic seeds from GSE181897-CONTROL-SOURCE-BOOTSTRAP-v1|comparator.
source_go_gate.post_go_freeze: Only after every source GO check passes, fit and publish all 63 selection-aware topology-null candidates under the already frozen source selection procedure. Internal access remains closed until every null and its implementation/input binding is publicly frozen.
source_go_gate.failure_policy: Publish the complete source result and close GSE181897 without internal numeric access. No threshold, grid, panel, donor, state, loss, or comparator may be changed to rescue the candidate.

bootstrap.sampling: Resample donors with replacement separately within each of the two physical batches, preserving each batch size; compute the equal-batch mean paired loss difference.
bootstrap.seed_formula: little-endian integer from the first eight bytes of SHA256(seed-salt|stage|comparator)

held_inference.exact_sign_test: One-sided exact donor sign test on nonzero paired loss differences, including equality with the observed favorable count in the tail. Zero differences count as one half favorable and one half unfavorable by doubling the denominator.
held_inference.batch_sensitivity: Both physical-pool mean paired differences must be strictly negative versus matched graph zero. Report each pool separately for every comparator; the equal-pool mean and bootstrap govern the prespecified classical and destroyed-link contrasts.

internal_validation_gate.role: single sealed go/no-go validation after source candidate freeze
internal_validation_gate.failure_policy: Publish the internal result and close confirmation access. Do not pool internal and confirmation donors, retune, rescore, replace a donor, or alter any contract.

primary_confirmation_gate.role: single primary held-pool confirmation, opened only after the internal gate passes
primary_confirmation_gate.interpretation: A pass is one same-study, donor-disjoint and pool-disjoint confirmation under the frozen GSE181897 protocol. It is not an independent-study replication.

sequential_access.physical_file_rule: The single public H5AD may exist locally as opaque bytes after acquisition. Local possession is not assay access. Access means dereferencing or decoding a numeric matrix dataset, and every authorized reader must publish the exact row, feature, and HDF5-dataset certificate it decoded.

stages.name: candidate_public_freeze
stages.exit: candidate annotated tag verified locally, remotely, and from a fresh clone

stages.name: axis_only_preflight
stages.exit: input digests and exact H5AD schema/axes published under an annotated tag

stages.name: implementation_and_runtime_freeze
stages.exit: reducers, model code, runners, tests, dependencies, runtime, salts, grids, output schemas, and file SHA-256 values bound under an annotated tag

stages.name: source_development
stages.numeric_x_access: only cond == C rows for frozen exp_ids in batches 0 through 7 and only axis-bound feature inputs; the reducer transparently constructs and stores same-cell source joint tables
stages.exit: source result, source candidate, all independently constructed training masks, final held mask, models, comparator selections, and all topology-null selections published

stages.name: internal_margin_and_prediction
stages.numeric_x_access: only separate RNA and protein marginal summaries for frozen exp_ids in batches 8 and 9; same-cell joint tables forbidden
stages.exit: margin certificate and predictions publicly frozen before score authorization

stages.name: internal_score
stages.numeric_x_access: one authorized construction of same-cell joint tables for frozen exp_ids in batches 8 and 9
stages.exit: complete pass or terminal negative/refusal published; confirmation stays closed unless every gate passes

stages.name: confirmation_margin_and_prediction
stages.numeric_x_access: only separate RNA and protein marginal summaries for frozen exp_ids in batches 10 and 11; same-cell joint tables forbidden
stages.exit: margin certificate and predictions publicly frozen before score authorization

stages.name: confirmation_score
stages.numeric_x_access: one authorized construction of same-cell joint tables for frozen exp_ids in batches 10 and 11
stages.exit: complete confirmation, negative result, or terminal refusal published

no_retuning_after_source: estimator family and all selected parameters
all comparator families and selected multipliers
loss, bootstrap, tests, gates, and thresholds
sequential_access.no_rescue: Internal and confirmation stages are scored separately in order. They cannot be pooled, reordered, repeated, partially reused, or replaced. A failure, support refusal, implementation exception, interruption after the attempt claim, or hash mismatch consumes that stage and closes downstream access.

internal margin, prediction, and score runner paths and SHA-256
confirmation margin, prediction, and score runner paths and SHA-256

Python, NumPy, SciPy, h5py/anndata, BLAS, operating-system, and machine versions
annotated public tag object, peeled commit, ancestry proof, remote verification, and fresh-clone verification
implementation_freeze.placeholder_rule: No source numeric access is authorized until every required binding replaces its PENDING value in a committed amendment and that amendment passes the public verification chain.

always_publish: all stage attempts and access certificates
all support counts, exclusions, refusals, and numerical certificates
complete source CV curves and comparator selections
donor and physical-batch loss vectors for every frozen method
relative reductions, bootstrap intervals, exact sign-test values, and topology empirical p-values
internal and confirmation outcomes separately, including negative or refused outcomes
